text: mika: Pushed an experiment for 'tight gutter' dashboard layout. It reduces horizontal padding and adds a toggle called "Highlight top-percentile" for single-line sparklines. Quick sanity check? jared: Love the denser canvas. Main concern: smoothing + tight gutters can hide short-lived spikes. If users rely on visual peaks for alerts they'll miss things. claire: Proposed pattern: always compute extremes from raw samples; render them separately from the smoothed path. Visual options: 1) tiny haloed marker for each extreme, 2) a translucent percentile band behind the line, 3) an anomaly summary chip in the legend. mika: Engineering note? ops-bot: Perf note: extra overlay layer must be GPU-composited. Avoid triggering layout on hover. jared: Implementation idea: add `rawIndices` to the chart payload so markers map to true samples. Also cap markers to avoid noise (e.g., show markers when <=5 anomalies in viewport). Otherwise show chip. claire: Accessibility: markers alone aren't enough. Keyboard + screen reader users need a readable summary on focus. Suggest aria-live summary like: "Sparkline (db-reads): min 12, median 48, max 780. 2 points above 95th percentile. Press Enter for details." a11y: Also ensure legend toggles have `role=button` and `aria-pressed`; use `aria-label` that includes the percentile value (e.g., "Highlight top percentile (95%)"). jared: Copy tweak: control label should be "Highlight top percentile (95%)" not just "Top percentile" so non-technical folks aren't guessing. Advanced settings can let users change 95 -> custom. claire: Tooltip microcopy: when overlay is visible show "value (raw)" and when smoothing is enabled show both labels "value (smoothed)" and "value (raw)". Also expose a small delta indicator. mika: Visual treatment for markers: 4px hollow circle + 2px halo. For extremely dense cases switch to a 2px vertical bar. Colors should use token `warning-500`. Ensure 3:1 contrast for the halo on small backgrounds. jared: Legend behavior in tight gutters: move series labels to overflow menu when container width < 280px. Overflow menu should list series name + latest value + anomaly count. design-bot: Figma updated: compact grid + examples for 0/3/10 anomalies. Link: . claire: ARIA sample to copy into component docs: ``` Sparkline (cache hits): min 0.01, median 0.2, max 1.5. 3 above 95th percentile. ``` claire: Also add `tabindex=0` to sparkline containers and `aria-describedby` to point to the legend chip for anomaly counts. mika: Acceptance criteria I'll add: default highlighting = on, compute from raw samples, markers when <=5 anomalies else show legend chip, aria-live summary present, tooltips show raw/smoothed labels, legend overflow pattern implemented, perf note about compositing. jared: tiny nit: label should read "Highlight top percentile (95%)" not "(95th)" to be friendlier. mika: Good catch, will update. I'll merge the PR after tests and ping for final a11y pass. a11y: +1 on live region wording. Remember to test with NVDA and VoiceOver. jared: :thumbsup:
